high_level_description: This image is a comparative map of China's high-speed rail network from the years 2008 and 2018. The map is divided into two sections, each representing a different year. Map: The left section shows a map of China with a limited number of high-speed rail lines marked. Lines: There are a few orange lines indicating existing high-speed rail lines capable of speeds above 300 km/h. These lines are concentrated primarily in the northeastern part of the country, connecting major cities like Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou. **
